# The Pinterest API in 2026.Trial Pins are only visible to you.

Pinterest's API v5 creates Pins on a user's boards with POST /pins and the pins:write scope, and lists no fee. New apps get Trial access, usually in 1 to 3 business days, but every Pin and board created on Trial is visible only to its creator. Public Pins need Standard access, which takes a demo video and a review with no stated duration.

Checked October 6, 2026. Breakreach is our product.

```
# 1. Register the video uploadcurl -X POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/media \  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -d '{"media_type": "video"}' # 2. Upload to the returned URL, with every upload_parameters fieldcurl -X POST "$UPLOAD_URL" \  -F key=$KEY -F policy=$POLICY -F x-amz-signature=$SIGNATURE \  -F x-amz-credential=$CREDENTIAL -F x-amz-algorithm=$ALGORITHM \  -F x-amz-date=$DATE -F x-amz-security-token=$SECURITY_TOKEN \  -F Content-Type=$CONTENT_TYPE -F file=@brew.mp4 # 3. Wait until its status is "succeeded"curl https://api.pinterest.com/v5/media/$MEDIA_ID \  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" # 4. The Pin, with a cover imagecurl -X POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/pins \  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -d '{    "board_id": "'$BOARD_ID'",    "title": "Pour-over in 3 pours, for a sweeter cup",    "link": "https://northbeam.coffee/brew-guide",    "media_source": {"source_type": "video_id", "media_id": "'$MEDIA_ID'",      "cover_image_url": "https://cdn.northbeam.coffee/pourover.jpg"}  }'
```

## The Pinterest API at a glanceWhat it takes before the first post.

PricePinterest lists no fee. The tiers are Trial and Standard access

Trial accessRequested in the developer portal, usually approved in 1 to 3 business days. Pins and boards created on Trial are visible only to their creator

Standard accessAn upgrade request with a video of your app's OAuth flow and an API action. No stated review time

Scopesboards:read, boards:write, pins:read and pins:write

Write limit300 a day per app on Trial; 100 a minute per user on Standard

Access tokens30 days. Continuous refresh tokens last 60 days and renew each time they're used

Your accountThe developer needs a Pinterest business account to run the app

Checked on October 6, 2026, from Pinterest's developer documentation and terms.

## How to get access to the Pinterest APIFrom a developer account to your first real post.

1. 1Use a business accountLog in to developers.pinterest.com with a Pinterest business account, verify its email and accept the Developer Terms.
2. 2Connect an app and request Trial accessRequests are reviewed every business day, and approval typically takes 1 to 3 business days, by email. The app id and secret then show under My apps.
3. 3Build on TrialUp to 1,000 requests a day per app, 300 of them writes. Everything you create is visible only to you, and the sandbox can't create video Pins.
4. 4Upgrade to StandardFrom the app card: a video of your app taking users through OAuth and completing an action with the API. Requests are reviewed regularly, with no stated duration.

Pinterest's Developer Guidelines add a rule for schedulers: the user must choose each Pin that gets published, so no bulk auto-posting.

## How to post with the Pinterest APIThe requests in the demo above, one by one.

1. 1Register the mediaPOST /v5/media with media_type video returns a **media_id**, an **upload_url** and **upload_parameters**.
2. 2Upload the fileA multipart POST to the upload_url with every upload parameter and the file: MP4, MOV or M4V.
3. 3Wait for processingGET /v5/media/{media_id} until status is succeeded (registered, processing, succeeded or failed).
4. 4Create the PinPOST /v5/pins with board_id, title, link and media_source: source_type video_id, the media_id and a cover_image_url. Pinterest's guide says a video Pin without a valid cover fails with 400.

An image Pin is a single call: POST /v5/pins with media_source source_type image_url. Multi-image Pins take 2 to 5 images, each with its own title and link.

## Common Pinterest API errorsWhat they mean and how to fix them.

| Error | What it means | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `Pins nobody else sees` | The app is on Trial: Pins and boards are visible only to their creator. | Upgrade to Standard access. |
| `Token is expired or invalid` | The 30-day access token expired, or the refresh token went 60 days unused. | Refresh, or send the user through OAuth again. |
| `Token has insufficient scopes` | A scope such as boards:write is missing. | Authorize again with the scopes. |
| `400 on a video Pin` | No valid cover image, or the media isn't processed yet. | Send a cover_image_url, and wait for succeeded. |
| `429` | Over the write limit: 300 a day on Trial, 100 a minute on Standard. | Back off; x-ratelimit-reset says when. |

## Pinterest API limitsRate limits, text and media.

- Rate limitsTrial: 1,000 requests a day per app, 300 of them writes. Standard: 100 writes a minute per user per app, and 100 requests a second overall.
- TextTitle up to 100 characters, description 800, link 2,048, alt text 500.
- ImagesBMP, JPEG, PNG, TIFF or WebP, up to 20 MB. Multi-image Pins take 2 to 5.
- VideoOrganic video Pins: MP4, M4V or MOV, 4 seconds to 5 minutes, 9:16 recommended.
- AccountUp to 2,000 boards and 200,000 Pins.

## Is the Pinterest API free?

Pinterest's developer docs list no fee or paid tier: the only tiers are Trial and Standard access.

What costs is Standard access. Until you have it, nothing you post is public, and the upgrade needs a finished app and a demo video.

Through Breakreach, a Pinterest account counts like any other connected account: $5 a month each up to 20, $3 up to 100, then $2.

## What the Pinterest API can't do

- Show Trial Pins to anyone but their creator
- Bulk auto-post: the user must choose each Pin that gets published
- Pin content the user didn't create: saving others' content is for the Save button
- Edit Pins on every app: PATCH /pins is in beta

## Post to Pinterest with Breakreach's APIOne request, scheduled, with retries.

POST /v1/posts

```
curl https://api.breakreach.com/v1/posts \  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BREAKREACH_API_KEY" \  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -d '{    "content": "Pour-over in 3 pours, for a sweeter cup",    "accountIds": ["6701a2f4c9e84b0012a3b4cc"],    "media": ["https://cdn.northbeam.coffee/brew.mp4", "https://cdn.northbeam.coffee/pourover.jpg"],    "pinterestBoardId": "1052942812345678901",    "pinterestLink": "https://northbeam.coffee/brew-guide",    "scheduledAt": "2026-10-07T09:00:00"  }'
```

What it posts on Pinterest

- Image PinsOne image on the board you pick. The first line becomes the title, up to 100 characters, and the text the description, up to 800.
- Video PinsOne MP4 or MOV video, with an image in the same post as its cover.
- Destination linkpinterestLink, up to 2,048 characters.
- Boards and statsGET /v1/pinterest-boards lists the boards; account stats give followers and monthly views.

Not yet

- Multi-image Pins
- Alt text
- Per-Pin stats

The full reference, webhooks and the price per connected account are on the [developers page](https://breakreach.com/developers), and the OpenAPI spec is at api.breakreach.com/v1/openapi.json.

FAQ

## Questions, answered.

Short answers about the Pinterest API.

Pinterest's developer docs list no fee or paid tier. The tiers are about access: Trial, where Pins are visible only to you, and Standard.

Your app is on Trial access: Pins and boards created on Trial are visible only to their creator. Standard access lifts it, after Pinterest reviews a demo video.

Trial access typically takes 1 to 3 business days. Standard requests are reviewed regularly, with no stated duration.

Register the upload with POST /v5/media, upload the file to the returned URL, wait for status succeeded, then POST /v5/pins with source_type video_id and a cover image.

Access tokens last 30 days. Refresh tokens are continuous: they last 60 days and renew each time you refresh. Apps created before September 25, 2025 must ask for them with continuous_refresh=true.

Pinterest's Developer Guidelines allow scheduling as long as the user chooses each Pin that gets published. Breakreach holds the post until scheduledAt.

$5 a month per connected account up to 20, $3 up to 100, then $2. You pay per connected account, never per post or per request.
